summary: This bill adds civil remedies in federal district court (with damages and attorney fees) for victims of sexual abuse crimes under chapters 109A and 117 of title 18, eliminates statutes of limitations for the most serious offenses in those chapters and for trafficking under sections 1589-1591, stays civil suits during related criminal cases, and creates a one-year lookback period to revive previously barred claims.

scores.thoughts: The bill contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budgets. It solely amends criminal and civil procedure statutes.

The bill amends chapters 109A and 117 and section 1595 of title 18 to create new civil remedies for victims of sexual abuse and related crimes, stays civil actions during criminal proceedings, and eliminates statutes of limitations for certain serious offenses. This expands victim access to civil justice within the criminal code framework, which aligns modestly with reform-oriented approaches rather than tougher criminal sentencing or policing.
